corrects: my own merged #6875 (0102df44d2) -- its N = 5 / N = 4 used a form valid only on the real axis
question: does the framework have a fibre-compute-then-project mechanism, and what does it select?
answer: the projection is the modulus on Delta(net), already in the block, and it is PARTIAL (E_0 unprojected) -- which is the whole source of the reality condition. Partial selects the SIXTH roots; full selects nothing. And all three reality-admissible phases are degenerate, so the root-of-unity sublocus is EMPTY.
scope: (a) for the reality arithmetic; the degeneracy exclusion is exact and theta-independent. Does NOT close route 5: |q| = 1 is more than its roots of unity, and a full projection remains available at the price of selecting nothing.

assertions.name: written_form_is_archimedean_only
assertions.detail: the written |q^2-2q-1|(q+1)/(2q^3) matches the block's |Delta(net)|*E_0 on the real axis (gap 0) and NOT off it (gap 2.407 at q = e^(i/3)) -- it follows only via |q^2-1| = (q-1)(q+1), which needs q real > 1. #6875's N = 5 / N = 4 are artifacts of that simplification.

assertions.name: partial_projection_selects_sixth_roots
assertions.detail: with the block's own partial projection, Q_beta is real on |q| = 1 iff sin phi (2 cos phi - 1) = 0, i.e. phi in {pi/3, pi, 5pi/3} -- the sixth roots, not the fifth (#6875 reading A) or the fourth (reading B)

assertions.name: full_projection_selects_nothing
assertions.detail: |Delta(net) * E_0| is real for EVERY q, so a full projection imposes no condition and selects no N. The projection question and the N question are therefore the SAME question. Adopting the full projection because it admits the required phase would be fitting the mechanism to the target; named here and not taken.

assertions.name: every_admissible_phase_is_degenerate_so_the_sublocus_is_EMPTY
assertions.detail: pi/3 and 5pi/3 kill the Hoefsmit coupling (q^4+q^2+1 = 0 identically at a primitive 6th root, since q^6-1 = (q^2-1)(q^4+q^2+1)); pi kills h. So reality admits exactly three phases and non-degeneracy excludes all three -- there is NO admissible root of unity on the fibre locus, a fact established before theta is mentioned.

assertions.name: theta_is_not_the_binding_constraint
assertions.detail: the required phase sits 18.5x below the nearest reality-admissible phase, but that is not the binding fact: the admissible set is empty on degeneracy grounds alone.
